ascents_vs_attempts.active_contracts_verdict: DISTINCT ACTIVE CONTRACTS: `ascents` is an Explore board-route public tick contract; `climb_attempts` (with `climbing_sessions`) is a private cross-discipline session logging contract.

climb_attempts.rls: Strictly private: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE owner and moderator only (013_mobile_social.sql:282-306). Hidden from public unless published via session_posts and aggregated in get_session_feed.
climb_attempts.purpose: Private per-user attempt log across all climbing disciplines; drives ProfileStatisticsCalculator (sessionCount, sendCount, attemptCount, sendRate, bestGrade) and session post publishing.
columns: session_id UUID REFERENCES climbing_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
user_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
board_route_id UUID REFERENCES routes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

ascents.purpose: Public route tick/ascent record specifically on board routes; drives Explore route consensus ratings and ticks.
columns: route_id UUID REFERENCES routes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
ascents.rls: Viewable on accessible routes (public, owner, moderator); insert/update/delete owner-only on accessible routes (011_secure_insert_policies.sql:78-152).

ascents_vs_attempts.clean_logger_reuse: Web Log/Activity should write directly to `climbing_sessions` and `climb_attempts` (reusing the exact mobile session domain). If an attempt logs a board climb (discipline='board', board_route_id=route.id) and outcome='sent', it can cleanly dual-record or link to an `ascents` row so route consensus ratings in Explore remain populated without mutating or deleting existing `ascents` history.

authorization_risks: Private session boundary: climbing_sessions and climb_attempts have owner/moderator-only SELECT policies (013:268-284). Any web or mobile query without a valid user JWT receives empty rows/errors.

Session post validity invariants: Trigger ensure_session_post_validity (013:227-229) requires session_id to be ended (ended_at IS NOT NULL) and owned by author, and featured_attempt_id to belong to the author and session. Reopening a session after post publishing is strictly rejected by prevent_published_session_reopen (013:201-213).

Immutability guards: prevent_social_parent_change (013:179-225) raises 42501 if user_id or session_id is modified on sessions/attempts/posts/likes/comments. Post id, created_at, and featured_attempt_id are also immutable.

Storage path enforcement: storage.objects RLS policies require owner folder prefixing matching auth.uid(): walls (<uid>/<wall_id>/... in 008:6-20), avatars (<uid>/... in 005:81-125), and social-media (<uid>/<post_id>.jpg in 013:703-738). session_posts.image_path is constrained to match lower(user_id)/lower(id).jpg.

Attempt timeline leak prevention: Table session_post_attempt_timeline_snapshots (013:107-111) has all privileges revoked from anon and authenticated; timeline data is accessible exclusively via the SECURITY DEFINER get_session_feed RPC.
